decoding.lossless_14bit: LibRaw 0.22.2 via rawpy 0.28.0 raw_image (Nikon lossless Huffman)
decoding.packed_14bit_stride10624: independent Python LSB-first packed-14 unpacker, 10,624 B row stride, 10,612 B payload (7 bytes -> 4 pixels); verified pixel-identical to LibRaw on all 20 packed-14 files in the tree
decoding.uncompressed_16bit_le_with_preview_overl: independent numpy '<u2' read at 12,128 B rows; rows overlapping the embedded preview JPEGs are excluded

geometry.center_roi: middle half of each 2020x3032 channel plane: rows 505:1515, cols 758:2274 -> 1010 x 1516 = 1,531,160 px per channel

comb_metric.roi: middle half of each axis of the R plane (plane rows 505:1515, cols 758:2274; full-frame even rows 1010:3030:2, even cols 1516:4548:2)
comb_metric.band_peak: max |rfft| over freqs in [0.22, 0.24]; the reported frequency is argmax_bin/16384
comb_metric.dominant_comb: max |rfft| over freqs in [0.05, 0.45]; spacing = 1/frequency, in DN

capture_mode_rule.method: geometric mean of max(Astro) and min(Standard) over the 11.17_modified22 anchor triples
capture_mode_rule.caveat: comb_band_0p22_0p24_peak is a per-frame diagnostic, not a build fingerprint: the original-firmware 5 s dark Z61_4854 (407,063) and Z61_4855 (98,408) differ 4.1x because their histogram combs sit at different frequencies (0.2278 vs 0.1586 cyc/DN, i.e. 4.39 vs 6.31 DN spacing).  capture_mode is therefore reported together with capture_mode_confidence and capture_mode_corroboration, and Stock is decided by provenance.

packed14_layout.discriminator: unpacking at stride 10,612 instead of 10,624 turns the frame into noise (mean |neighbour diff| jumps from ~7 DN to thousands of DN)

u16_overlay_layout.encoding: 16-bit little-endian, every value < 16384 (14-bit in a 16-bit container)
u16_overlay_layout.note: three preview JPEGs (byte-identical copies of the file's own SubIFD1 large preview, IFD0 thumbnail and SubIFD3 medium preview) are embedded inside the declared RAW strip; rows 3633-4000 must be dropped

field_notes.pixel_stats: over the SensorArea (8,8,6048,4024) crop of the correctly decoded frame; for the three 16-bit LE files the preview-overlay rows are excluded
field_notes.frame_category: Bias/Dark/Flat/Scene from exposure_time and the fraction of valid-area pixels above black_level+128 = 1136 ADU
field_notes.libraw_packed14_misdecode_artifact: True only for the 5 s Astro frames stored as uncompressed 16-bit LE, which LibRaw mis-decodes as packed-14

auxiliary_non_nef_files.role: auxiliary non-NEF file (excluded from the NEF count)
